summary: take aim Say a Name Proclaim!! defame those whose shame and misname to acclaim fame The endgame Reclaim names of those slain who overcame the freeze-frame of racist history #smallpoems #lra2020
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
take aim
Say a Name
   Proclaim!!
defame
  those
whose
  shame
and misname
  to acclaim
   fame
The endgame
  Reclaim
 names of
those slain
  who overcame
  the freeze-frame
   of
      racist
       history
#smallpoems
#lra2020
